Blood Claw.d: Poisons your target's blood, causing 20 initial damage and 15 damage every 6 seconds for up to 12 secs (2 ticks).

Bramblecoat.d: Surrounds your body in a coat of brambles that increases your armor class, as well as harming those that strike you.

Dance of the Fireflies.d: Summons a swarm of mystic fireflies to your hands, providing light in dark areas.

Dismiss Undead.d: A burst of holy power that inflicts 211 damage to an undead target.

Elemental: Fire.d: Summons a fire elemental to aid you in battle.

Engulfing Darkness.d: Summons an engulfing darkness that binds your target's feet decreasing their movement rate, and doing 11 damage every 6 seconds for 1 min.

Illusion: Dark Elf.d: Cloaks you in a shimmering illusion that makes you appear to be a Dark Elf.

Lifetap.d: Drains your target of life energy, siphoning 6 hit points.

See Invisible.d: Places a magical enchantment upon your target's eyes, allowing them to see otherwise invisible creatures for 27 min.

Steal Strength.d: Weapon proc. Superior to Siphon Strength

Steelskin.d: Surrounds your skin in a protective aura that absorbs 230 damage. Consumes a jasper when cast.

Strong Poison.d: Poisons your target, causing 30 damage initially and 14 damage every 6 seconds for up to 2 minutes.

Weaken.d: Weakens your opponent, lowering their strength.

Ykesha.d: This DD proc will interrupt spells and cause 475 hate.
